0.0: Hello, hello! I have come to magnanimously barter for your much-needed second piece of information.\r\n#L0##bHuh? You mean this envelope with the green seal? #l\n#k
0.1: Yes, tha-what? How did you... Where did you get that?\r\n#L0##bI thought we were supposed to TRADE for information.#l\n#k
0.2: Ha! Well done, my combative friend, well done. You have the makings of a superlative merchant. Very well, if you reveal how you obtained that information, I will give you the third piece you surely desire. Thus a fair trade is born, no?

yes.0: Wonderful! So, how did it happen?

no.0: As you like. I reside on the losing side of this exchange, after all.

1.0: Come, come! Details, details!\r\n#L0##bI just traded with someone named #p3001005#. I complete his task, and he gave me #t4033398#.#l\n#k
1.1: Ahh, #p3001005#. You may rest assure that he is a trustworthy soul, so your information should check out. Sigh...beaten again by #p3001005#. He's too good. \r\n#L0##bToo good?#l\n#k
1.2: In truth, #p3001005# is an incredible merchant, and a disciple of the school of strongarm tactics. My theatrics have never quite measured up, so I do my best to be more mobile. He's beaten me this time. Now, I'll grant you your intelligence, so I have one last request. When next you meet #p3001005#, trade with him anyway.\r\n#L0##bHuh? Why?#l\n#k
1.3: Because I long to see #b#p3001005##k helped. This will be as volunteer work for you, yes? Now that you have what you seek.

yes.0: This envelope is the fee. You know what to do, right? Farewell, then, and good fortune in your travels!
